text:
Alex G.: Heads-up — we need a 60m privsec sync next week to finalize the threat model + audit checklist for Q2 SOC prep.

Proposed agenda (60m):
1) Threat model walkthrough (15m) — Maya lead
2) Access owners & gap review (15m) — Sanjay lead
3) Audit artifacts status + missing items (20m) — Alex lead
4) Action items & owners (10m)

Proposed slots (PT): Tue 4/12 10:00-11:00, Wed 4/13 09:00-10:00, Fri 4/15 11:00-12:00.
Pre-reads: https://redwood-internal.docs/privsec/q2-audit-prep (please skim threat model v1 and access matrix).
Ping: @Maya R. @Sanjay K. @Lina T. — reply with preferred slot or "any" and call out if you need an invite to include Compliance/Privacy.

Maya R.: Wed 9-10 PT works best for me. I can walk the threat model updates (brief slide deck + attack surface sketch). I'll tag privacy SME in doc. :+1:

Sanjay K.: Tue works for me but Fri is tough. I can own access review. Will attach the IAM audit checklist + last export of access logs (s3://redwood-audit/last-export).

Lina T.: Any is fine but prefer Wed as well. Can we add "data retention mapping" as a short item? I have a 5-min summary. Also recommend inviting @Ravi (privacy).

sec-bot: Quick poll: react with :thumbsup: for Wed, :thumbsdown: if you can only do Tue, :speech_balloon: if Fri only. Auto-schedule when 3+ thumbs up.

Alex G.: Sounds like Wed 9-10 PT is the likely winner (Maya + Lina + me). @Sanjay you said Tue but can you move to Wed? If yes I'll schedule and include Compliance + Privacy. If not, we should pick Tue.

Sanjay K.: I can move to Wed, confirm. I'll bring access review notes and the IAM checklist.

Alex G.: Great — scheduling Wed 4/13 09:00-10:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + agenda and upload slides by EOD today.

Action items (quick):
- Alex G.: create invite, add Compliance/Privacy, upload slides + deck link in pre-reads.
- Maya R.: threat model v2 slides (10 slides) and attack-surface diagram.
- Sanjay K.: access matrix + IAM audit checklist, link s3 export.
- Lina T.: data retention mapping short doc, list of sensitive stores.

Alex G.: Anything else to add to agenda? If not, I'll tag owners in the invite and mark pre-reads mandatory.

Sanjay K.: Add reminder to bring any recent RBAC changes since last review (PR list).

Maya R.: Also recommend we run the threat-model quick checklist during the meeting: 
```
- entry points
- auth & session handling
- data flows of PII
- fallback & degradation modes
- logging & observability
```

Alex G.: Perfect — added. Thanks everyone. Invite out in ~10m. :calendar:
